nan16_vm_universality.claim: fixed 23x8 Minsky table executed by the Coq NaN16 fixture VM simulates every finite run of the left-infinite binary-tape source machine
nan16_vm_universality.scope: Fixed 23x8 table and the Coq model of the literal NaN16 fixture mth/tests/mth_minsky_test.nas. For every p, rows, c with Forall (wide_row_wellformed p) rows, rows <> [], length (lic_state c) = p, and left_infinite_ok c, the left-infinite source halts iff the closed NaN16 VM run halts from the K-window encoding of the same initial source configuration.
nan16_vm_universality.window_note: The halting equivalence is exists K t, K >= t. K is the left-window depth and may grow with native time t; the window premise is not a separate bridge hypothesis, and a total run-time-independent encode is not claimed.
not_proved: refinement of third_party/nan0s/core/nan16.c or the NaN0S C++ VM (exec_instr is a trusted Coq ISA model)
